title: SS27 Girls' Woven Silhouette Direction
summary: Girls' woven shapes: pleated, tiered and reversible dresses, puff-sleeve blouses, wide shorts and skirts, sailor-collar tops.
research_period: Pitti Bimbo 103, Florence, 24-25 June 2026; Playtime Paris, 28-30 June 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Premium and mid-market childrenswear, Europe-led fairs, global retail

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Fatamadrina lists relaxed shapes, dungarees, oversized T-shirts, pleated dresses and lightweight jackets as SS27 silhouettes<sup>[1]</sup>
- Poco Blush, designed "almost exclusively for girls", showed bold hues and a loose, printed, reversible dress, and a T-shirt that releases a minty scent when crumpled<sup>[2]</sup>
- Sailor collars, navy blues and nautical details appeared throughout Playtime Paris<sup>[3]</sup>

sections.heading: Shapes to lead with
sections.body:
- **Pleated and tiered dresses.**
- **Loose reversible dress.**
- **Puff-sleeve blouse.**
- **Wide shorts and skorts.**
- **Sailor-collar dress.**

design_implications:
- Easy openings; back buttons only from older sizes.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
